assumptions: Standard finite undirected unit-edge Abelian sandpile on K_{a,b}, a,b>=2; sink in a-part; fixed adjacent addition in b-part; uniform recurrent states.
integrity: The claim is proved using an explicit bijection, Dhar burning and forbidden-subconfiguration criteria, matrix-tree counts, and the stationary Green function; finite tests are checks and not substituted for proof.
scientific_limitations: Does not classify the full avalanche-size distribution or nonadjacent additions.
Historical priority has residual risk from unindexed equivalent treatments.
title: Full-system Abelian sandpile avalanches on complete bipartite graphs: a deletion-tree law and a rare-event activity fraction
